method: Platt recalibration, OOS-validated (train/test split by ticker)
why: synthetic-strike backtest showed contract_prob systematically under-predicts P(clear strike) by ~14pp because firms beat consensus ~72% of the time; a near-pure intercept shift (b~=1) corrects it. Applies to strike/contract probabilities only.
reversible: delete this file to revert to raw contract_prob
